findings.title: Heartbeat siren criteria use unresolved clock origins
findings.analysis: VS-FI-10 states siren <=0.5 s but records approximately 0.56 s after the last heartbeat. Section 4 instead says <=0.5 s after detection. VS-FI-09 also uses 0.5 s without an explicit clock. These are not interchangeable; the record cannot establish failure or success until the clock and tolerance are explicit.
findings.author_action: Provide a timing-event dictionary (fault onset, last valid heartbeat, detection, revocation, physical acoustic onset). Map each criterion to its governing requirement and clock, budget task phase/jitter and instrument uncertainty, and propose consistent VS-FI/VS-UV/VS-VAL wording.
findings.closure_evidence: Reviewed event definitions and requirement trace, actual synchronized target/acoustic measurements, worst-case margin and anomaly disposition. Do not reset the clock to remove a discrepancy.
